mapper.select: SELECT membership.membership_id, subject.login_name, membership.membership_role, membership.status, membership.permission_version, membership.created_at FROM organization_access.tenant_membership membership INNER JOIN organization_access.subject_identity subject ON subject.subject_id = membership.subject_id WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY subject.login_name ASC, membership.membership_id ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
